system.description: When a foe moves out of a space adjacent to you (except via a Step), you may spend an Action to make an Attack Action as an Interrupt against that foe. On Success, roll damage and apply any other effects from the Attack!

upgrades.description: If the foe moves into another space adjacent to you, they must stop.
A foe using their Step no longer prevents this ability.
Roll the Attack Skill Check with Advantage.

system.limitations: Requires a single-handed melee weapon with a range no greater than 5 feet.
